thesis: CRVL has run a long way, and the entry sits in a risk-off tape where high-multiple winners are exposed to a de-rating. Valuation is rich with no peer or forward context, and the stock is up 34.8% over 63 days, so good news is largely priced in. The earnings 8-K and 10-Q were filed days ago with content unreviewed, so whether the 11-03 reversal bar and the failed push to the 52-week high reflect a disappointing print is unknown; this is missing data, not a binary event. The target is the same 89.76 high that just failed, and a close under the 78.9 stop or the SMA50 would void the uptrend structure.

rebuttal_to_bull: The bull reads the pullback as relative strength, but the stock is down two sessions from a failed high and the cards cannot say whether the 11-03 earnings reaction was negative; the 'no event risk' point only covers the next earnings date, not the unreviewed print. Reward/risk of about 2.2 depends on the target breaking the exact high that just rejected price. Risk-off regimes compress rich multiples, and quality and growth do not protect a P/E of 34.9 after a 34.8% run. The bull itself concedes valuation, regime and the unknown 8-K are weaknesses.
